theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_rescaled_restriction_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U O : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Varifold N n O) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → (∀ y ∈ O, ξ + t • y ∈ U) → IsIntegral V → W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → IsIntegral W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
